column3: MT 5:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “To the choirmaster” is rendered “To the Chief Musician,” and הֲגִיגִי (“my sighing”) “my meditation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I arrange for you” is rendered “I will direct it to You,” and “I will watch” “I will look up.”
Close to the Hebrew; חַסְדְּךָ (“your steadfast love”) is rendered “Your mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; נְכוֹנָה (“what is reliable”) is rendered “faithfulness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “seek refuge” is rendered “put their trust,” and “you cover over them” “because You defend them.”
